item.title: Exclusive: 1834 Hotels promotes Rod Harrex as new CEO
item.description: Rod Harrex has been promoted to Chief Executive Officer at 1834 Hotels, as founder Andrew Bullock transitions to Executive Chairman. The post Exclusive: 1834 Hotels promotes Rod Harrex as new CEO appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: First look: Inside the new Radisson Red Auckland
item.description: Touted as an ”upper-upscale” hotel, Radisson Red Auckland has officially opened its doors to guests, marking the brand’s Australasian debut and the first of the brand's two new hotels to arrive in New Zealand. The post First look: Inside the new Radisson Red Auckland appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Chemical Free Hotels
item.description: Ozone Hospitality Services introduces advanced steam cleaning at Emporium, delivering safer hygiene, stronger operational efficiency, and a modern approach to hospitality cleaning built on technology and long-term performance. item.title: Press Play & Taste at Elements of Byron
item.description: On Saturday, 14th February, Nespresso Professional bought its vibrant Press Play & Taste summer experience to Elements of Byron - transforming the luxury eco‑resort into a full‑venue celebration of premium iced coffee moments. item.title: Global exclusive: Accor’s Jean-Yves Minet on Novotel’s new ‘Longevity Everyday’ wellness vision
item.description: Accor’s founding brand Novotel is getting firmly behind supporting guests’ wellbeing and quality of life through a new vision called ‘Longevity Everyday’ and it’s set to be a global sensation, Novotel’s Global Brand President, Jean-Yves Minet, exclusively tells James Wilkinson.
